event: Identify the location of the speaker relative to a robot's position and orientation when the speech topic 'suggesting stopping the recording' comes up.

sounding_object.description: Adult male with curly dark hair, wearing a light green short-sleeved collared shirt, dark shorts, glasses, and a headset with a microphone. Approximately 1.75m tall.

reference_object.description: A Cuisinart brand stainless steel countertop oven/air fryer. Silver/metallic color. Approximate dimensions: 40cm wide, 30cm high, 35cm deep. Located on the main kitchen counter, near the stove.

facing_object.description: A stainless steel double wall oven, built into white kitchen cabinets. Located on the left-side wall of the kitchen area, perpendicular to the main counter run. Approximately 60-70cm wide.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the countertop oven and facing the stainless steel double wall oven, when the speech topic: "suggesting stopping the recording" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
